$comment: capability-rows-the-code-does-not-yet-meet task 15 (REQ-CLR-022): a compliance claim reads verified only after a reviewer of another organisation than the supplier marks it (POST /api/compliancy/{id}/verify). These fields are written by that action only; ComplianceVerificationGuard refuses them on every other write and clears them when the evidence changes.

verifiedBy.description: The reviewer who checked the evidence and marked the claim verified.
verifiedBy.title: Verified by

verifiedAt.description: When the reviewer marked the claim verified.
verifiedAt.title: Verified on

verifiedByOrganisation.description: The organisation of the reviewer; never the supplier's.
verifiedByOrganisation.title: Verified by organisation
